completion_decisions: The target assets are the new complex-terrain Gaussian-streamline wake evaluator and double-stage lifecycle; seven generic MATLAB/toolbox comparators are comparison-only baselines.
The private Northwest-China field is represented by a separately named open proxy derived from PyWake ParqueFicticio WAsP grids; no author-site replay is claimed.
Figure 2 coordinates are digitized in rotor-diameter units and checked against the four-diameter constraint.
The CT curve is a declared piecewise completion anchored exactly at the printed CT=0.747 at 7 m/s.
Random search follows the paper and Algorithm 1 of cited predecessor DOI 10.1016/j.renene.2015.01.005.
Paper CPU-second stopping is retained for formal execution; explicit stage FES are used only for portable H5/H6 admission.
missing_information: private Northwest-China terrain and WAsP CFD grids
author streamline arrays and exact Figure-2 coordinates
complete power and CT arrays and sector probabilities
author MATLAB code and toolbox settings
seeds, histories, and portable stopping budget

paper.authors: Roberto Brogna and Ju Feng and Jens Nørkær Sørensen and Wen Zhong Shen and Fernando Porté-Agel
paper.title: A New Wake Model and Comparison of Eight Algorithms for Layout Optimization of Wind Farms in Complex Terrain

used_assets: ParqueFicticio WAsP 30 m and 200 m grids
streamline-distance implementation as an independent design reference

paper_source_conflicts: The site, flow grids, exact layout, and full turbine curves are private or absent.
Table 2 displays speed and direction units in swapped columns.
The paper reports 5000-second and 20000-second CPU limits but no portable FES or hardware-equivalent budget.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of equations, domain, constraints, double-stage lifecycle, and open-proxy complex-terrain behavior; not the private Northwest-China benchmark or author-numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 6000 m by 4000 m bounds and four-diameter pairwise spacing; infeasible random moves are resampled

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct metric coordinates; Figure-2 points are digitized in diameter units

initialization.resolution: one Figure-2-digitized layout and ten uniform random feasible layouts

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: normalized effective-speed objective and elapsed time over eleven initial layouts

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize sector-probability-weighted effective speed normalized by 7 m/s

paper_native_cases.authority: target paper plus declared open proxy
paper_native_cases.resolution: 25 turbines on a 6000 m by 4000 m complex-terrain flow field; semantic ID explicitly identifies the open proxy

parameters.authority: target paper then cited predecessor then declared completion
parameters.resolution: D=93 m, hub=67 m, k*=0.042, 1 percent exclusion, 25 m streamline step, fixed equal-area rotor quadrature

stopping_and_physical_fes.authority: target paper and platform admission protocol
stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: paper formal run uses 5000-second no-wake plus 20000-second wake stages; one complete twelve-sector farm objective is one physical FES

update_order.resolution: sequential accept-if-better random search with remembered accepted turbine/direction; only evaluator sectors are concurrent

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.authority: target Eqs. 1-14 plus declared CT completion
wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: pseudo-3D streamline Gaussian wake, rotor averaging, 2D-to-40D inclusion, and RSS superposition

wind_and_scenario_sampling.authority: target paper plus declared open proxy
wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: twelve sectors at 30-degree increments; proxy supplies local frequency, speedup, turn, inclination, and elevation
